<!--
PURPOSE  Formulate one multivariable research question, test it with an
         appropriate model, visualise the result and draw a conclusion.
INPUT    data/processed/nhanes_clean.csv (via load_clean_data())
OUTPUT   results/figures/fig_03_*, results/tables/tab_03_*
OWNER    Person 2

ASSIGNMENT REQUIREMENTS
  - one outcome + at least two explanatory variables (adjustment, interaction
    or combined effect)
  - testable with the data provided (check before committing)
RUBRIC (5/5)
  - hypothesis clearly defined, relevant, multivariable
  - correct test for the data type; assumptions checked (normality of residuals,
    equal variance, independence); p-values, confidence intervals and effect
    sizes explained
  - publication-quality figure that directly supports the hypothesis
-->
